scope: Pure source/plan validation and static review of Mercado Pago XLSX contract, file preservation, phases, optional SKU and publication claims.
fixture: Synthetic products only. No real catalogue, provider data, account IDs or credentials are included.

results.name: 93 approved products produce 186 unique variants in two phases
Price range accepted and zero, string, NaN, boolean rejected
A 201st category is rejected without replacing existing categories
An empty product source does not manufacture supplier or product rows
A product pending approval is excluded from newly generated rows
Bootstrap rejects equal names with conflicting prices

resolved_findings.issue: Fixed source column positions could silently exchange phase prices after header changes.
resolved_findings.resolution: Exact header guards added for A/B/D/J/M/Q, row 3.

resolved_findings.issue: Workbook path checks did not verify template version or semantic headers.
resolved_findings.resolution: Exact guards added for MLM_DEFAULT_DOCUMENT, doc_version 1.0.6 and target headers.

resolved_findings.issue: Optional nonempty manually supplied SKU values were not checked for duplicates.
resolved_findings.resolution: Static review confirmed DEST_SKU_DUPLICATE guard for existing F5:F997 values. Column F remains outside the write allowlist; SKU is not treated as a Mercado Pago upsert key.

remaining_review_item.note: Deployment and real Google Apps Script execution remain unverified.

static_conclusions: Only product cells B/C/I and category cells B6:B205 are changed by the writer.
Untouched ZIP parts are preserved and checked by hash.
Solar/Eclipse and Lunar are phases; no event identifiers are created or inferred.
Provider records do not automatically become product records.
SKU is optional and does not establish Mercado Pago upsert semantics.
Reported status separates file generation from Mercado Pago import and terminal verification.
Products removed or no longer approved are retained as HOLD entries; heldVariants requires review before import, rather than implying a mirror of active products.
limits: These checks execute local JavaScript in Node; Google Apps Script services were not executed.
No triggers were installed, no live API write was performed and no Mercado Pago import was tested by this reviewer.
No claim of publication or synchronization to terminals is made.
An updated module requires re-running the checks; this evidence identifies the exact reviewed code hash.

reproduction.runtime: Node.js with built-in fs, vm and crypto modules; no network access required.
